activities.name: Story analysis / spec for integration tickets

states.name: PR

activities.name: Code review (human)
activities.note: Median time to first review decision 22 h (79,200 s), n=17 completed PRs in window. 9 of 17 PRs (53%) needed two or more review rounds.

activities.name: PR validation build (build + NUnit + WSDL snapshot)
activities.note: Median 540 s (9 min). 2 of 17 PR builds failed (12%).

states.note: Branch policy: one reviewer and a green PR validation build.

states.name: main branch

activities.name: Post-merge CI (build + pack)
activities.note: Median 600 s (10 min). 1 of 24 runs failed (4%). Healthy: leave alone.

transitions.guard: Package published to the internal feed

states.note: Source of truth for deployable packages.

states.name: Integration QA

activities.name: tSQLt suite on shared FsCore_QA
activities.note: 7 of 20 runs failed (35%), median 840 s (14 min). Dominant failure mode: fixtures written without the tsqlt_ prefix collide with a concurrent run on the shared database. Re-run usually passes.

transitions.guard: On-prem build is deployed to Dev; the router owner starts the router pipeline

states.note: One shared QA database for all branches.

states.name: Cloud router pipeline

activities.name: Router build + OpenAPI generation
activities.note: Median 420 s (7 min). 1 of 12 router runs failed (8%).

activities.name: Contract drift / Swagger completeness review (manual)
activities.note: Reviewer compares the WSDL snapshot with the OpenAPI document by hand, median 1,500 s (25 min). 4 of 12 router PRs (33%) received a contract-drift review comment.

transitions.guard: Router PR merged and router build green

states.note: Route registered per consumer; OpenAPI generated from route metadata.

states.name: Staging

activities.name: Consumer smoke test (manual)
activities.note: Median 1,800 s (30 min), run by the consumer owner. 1 of 10 smoke tests found a defect.

transitions.guard: Consumer owner confirms the smoke test

states.note: Staging mirrors Production configuration except data volume.

states.name: Production

activities.name: Release notes and rollback section authoring (manual)
activities.note: Median 1,800 s (30 min). 6 of the last 10 releases (60%) shipped without a rollback section in the release notes.

activities.name: Deploy on-prem service, then router
activities.note: Median 780 s (13 min). 1 of 20 deploys failed and was re-run (5%).

states.note: Production deploys are manual per component. Rollback is configuration-first (route switch).
